sources.title: Minzdrav USSR order 18.06.1987 No. 817 — massage load units (zone list with anatomical bounds)
sources.legal: Repealed in RF (Minzdrav 15.12.2023 No. 697). Still the de-facto CIS spa/physio zone vocabulary.

sources.title: A.E. Shcherbak segmental galvanization / electrophoresis (collar + panty zones)
CIS peloid/paraffin application names (collar, panties, trousers, gloves, socks)
Balneology fill/site: full bath, sitz, to-waist, four-chamber

notes: S is doctor-facing. A (FMA/TA) is a pre-bound underlay — not picked on the visit.
Prikaz 817 items 15 and 18 (segmental massage) are the same sites as 14 and 17 — method, not extra S codes.
fmaId is a lookup hint, not a licensed SNOMED identifier. Confirm against FMA/BioPortal before seed.
Canon era-clinic/doc/physio-site-canon.md wins if this file disagrees.
4 lü = electrode count, not Amplipuls work-kind IV (that is 4 cu rej).
Sock/glove strings alias foot/hand S. APPLICATION_CUT is legacy; matcher still maps those phrases to S.
böyrəküstü / böyrək üstü = lumbosacral (above the kidneys), not a new S.
sadə on inhalation = no additive, not a site. rus akimi = Kotz, not SMT I–V.
dizdən aşağı / asagi eyaqlar = below the knee → ZONE-FOOT-LEG, not the whole lower limb.
baldır = crus (ZONE-FOOT-LEG). bud = thigh / hip-gluteal. Not the same S.
artroz pr / artrit rej = stim program, not PRP (SVC-PRP-TERAPIYA is a different SKU).
BTL 4000: any electro procedures in parallel on the two split-room outputs. 4-pad capability only 12/13; those couches also serve 2-pad. FIFO, no hold.
Resource occupancy is planning-only in naftaResourceSketch — not runtime schema.

orderFieldsNotZones.meaning: Apply listed S sites in turn, not one combined patch
Several S in one session as one combined application. Default when multiple chips without növbəli.
Amplipuls SMT роды работы I–V. WO 4 cu rej = IV, 2 ci rej = II. Not electrode count.
Named program/current on the stim (not Amplipuls I–V): TENS, Kotz, interferential, artroz/artrit templates. artroz pr = proqram, NOT PRP.
2 vs 4 plates (WO 4 lü, 2 li, 4 basliqli). Not Amplipuls work-kind IV. 2-pad: all six electro couches (12/13 as 2 of 4). 4-pad capability: 12/13 when free. FIFO; do not hold 12/13.
Frequency / pulse / duration tokens — ProcedureType, not S
wo: mualicede n once su icmek lazimdir

orderFieldsNotZones.meaning: Plain / no plant or drug additive (typical on inhalation). Not a site.
Front vs back of an already chosen S (or full body). Not extra S codes.
N days on site A then N days on site B (paraffin / darsonval). Distinct from növbəli (same slot) and from naftalan BATH_SEQUENCE.
Day-1 sitz then full (naftalan). Two S over time, not one zone.
wo: 1 ci gün oturaq sonraki gün tam
1 ci gün oturaq sonraki günlər tam

orderFieldsNotZones.meaning: Drug / plant / nicotine — electrophoresis, inhalation, UFF. Not anatomy.
Naftalan smear (surtulsun) — remaining tokens are smear sites, not fill line
UFF / naftalan: extra oil (bol yağla). Consumable note, not a site.
Massage intensity (Massaj 15 yungul = light; zəif = weak; isti olmasin = not hot)
Stop / withhold the application. Order action, not anatomy.
Procedure title written into nahiye (e.g. shockwave). Not a site.
Vertebral qualifier on an S (L4–L5 ≠ Amplipuls IV). Not a new S.
Legacy peloid clothing phrases. Canon: these alias foot/hand S; matcher still strips then implies ZONE-FOOT-LEG / ZONE-HAND-FOREARM.

zones.boundary: Fronto-temporal and occipito-parietal regions (817 §1).
Hairy scalp — darsonval / solux local, narrower than 817 head.
Frontal, peri-orbital, maxillary regions (817 §2).
Neck only, without collar flap (817 §3).

zones.titleLa: Regio cervicalis posterior et pars superior dorsi
zones.boundary: Posterior neck, back down to Th IV, anterior chest to 2nd rib (817 §4). Same patch as Shcherbak collar electrode.
Whole upper limb (817 §5).

zones.titleEn: Upper limb, shoulder girdle and scapula
zones.boundary: 817 §6 — limb plus shoulder girdle and scapular region.
Upper third of arm, shoulder joint, ipsilateral girdle (817 §7).
817 §10. Glove strings (əlcək, elcek) are aliases of this S, not a separate cut field.
Anterior chest from girdle to costal arches + back C7–L1 (817 §11).
C7–L1 between mid-axillary lines (817 §12). Not the full spine strip.
L1 to inferior gluteal folds (817 §14). Segmental massage (817 §15) is the same site.
C7 to sacral base, mid-axillary to mid-axillary (817 §16).
Posterior neck and back to L1 between posterior axillary lines (817 §17). §18 segmental = same site.
Posterior neck + back + lumbosacral between posterior axillary lines (817 §19).
Foot, leg, thigh, gluteal and lumbosacral (817 §21).
817 §22 hip joint + gluteal. WO bud / quadriseps / hamstring (thigh) alias here. Not baldır (crus), not Shcherbak panty, not bare biceps (arm).
817 §25. Sock strings (corab, noski) are aliases of this S, not a separate cut field. baldır = crus, not thigh. dizdən aşağı / asagi eyaqlar belong here, not ZONE-LOWER-LIMB.
Shcherbak girdle: lumbar electrode + upper-thigh electrodes. Not a bath (ZONE-SITZ) and not a hip joint (ZONE-HIP-GLUTEAL). Rare in WO nahiye; keep for electro/galvano.
Immersion of pelvic region only (naftalan sitz). Related to panty zone but a bath fill, not an electrode patch.
Water line at waist — lower trunk + lower limbs.
General bath / general massage. 817 §26 is paediatric general massage — same site idea.
Both hands and both feet in four cells — not a single anatomical region.
WO BodyParts id=9. Local point, not 817 §14. bel oma does not imply coccyx; 'büzdüm bel oma' is two chips.
WO BodyParts (sağ/sol qulaq) — local, not in 817 massage list.

closedDecisions.decision: Gloves/socks alias ZONE-HAND-FOREARM / ZONE-FOOT-LEG. Not extra S codes.
closedDecisions.why: Canon 2026-08-25. APPLICATION_CUT remains only so old WO clothing phrases still strip.

closedDecisions.decision: Keep ZONE-COCCYX. bel-oma does not include it.
closedDecisions.why: WO BodyParts id=9 Büzdüm sümüyü. 817 §14 is L1 to gluteal folds (region). Coccyx is a local point (Amplipuls/darsonval). WO 'büzdüm bel oma' → two chips.

closedDecisions.decision: Bare boyun = ZONE-COLLAR (Nafta reception: trapezius / scalenus collar patch). ZONE-NECK stays 817 §3 for explicit neck-only, no WO alias.
closedDecisions.why: Nafta reception 2026-08-25: boyun is the collar (trapezius / scalenus), not 817 §3 neck-only. Isolated WO boyun (88 rows) maps to COLLAR. baş boyun → HEAD+COLLAR.

closedDecisions.decision: Three codes. Do not collapse.
closedDecisions.why: oturaq 1361/235 is sitz bath (hydro fill). bud çanaq is 817 §22 joint + laterality (BodyParts sağ/sol). Panty is Shcherbak electrode girdle (lumbar + upper thighs), not a bath and not a hip joint. Rename hip so it never says oturaq.

closedDecisions.decision: Match S only after stripping order-field tokens from the nahiye string.
closedDecisions.why: 4 cu rej / artroz rej / tens / növbəli / sağ-sol are not anatomy.

closedDecisions.decision: növbəli is siteApplyMode=TURN on one ProcedureOrder (same slot, sites in listed order). Not two series and not sequenceIndex FIFO.
closedDecisions.why: WO stores növbəli on a single PatientProcedure row. sequenceIndex already means program FIFO (confirm order of procedure types). Day-rotate fill is BATH_SEQUENCE only (1 ci oturaq son tam). eyni vaxtda = TOGETHER.

closedDecisions.decision: When nahiye is empty, default S from procedure name (Nafta reception 2026-08-25).
closedDecisions.why: Yod-brom / hidromasaj / Massaj 30 / UFB / Bükmə → FULL-BODY. Limfodrenaj empty → LOWER-LIMB (add ABDOMEN if qarın marked). Massaj 15 still needs a region. Naftalan fill stays doctor-assigned (tam|oturaq|qurşaq).

closedDecisions.decision: 4 lü = 4 electrodes. 4 cu rej = Amplipuls work-kind IV. Never the same field.
closedDecisions.why: Textbook SMT I–V vs WO 4 lü on two sites and on electrophoresis.

closedDecisions.decision: kali yodla=ky-la=KI; kalsiilə/kalsiiləe=Ca; novakainlə=novocaine; karipazin/kariipazimlə=caripazim; dimeksid; hidrokortizon; maqni sulfat; mg-le=Mg; mazi ile=ointment.
closedDecisions.why: Elektroforez nahiye is drug + sites + optional 4 lü plates. L4 L5 is spine level, not regime IV.

closedDecisions.decision: sonr4a=sonra; 1 ci dün=1-ci gün; siyine=çiyinə; qurşaqədər=qurşağa qədər; bədn=bədən; tan beden=tam; 4kamerali=four-chamber naftalan procedure.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-25.

closedDecisions.decision: Keep four paraffin SKUs. Extra nahiye (3 gün/5 gün, boyunçiyin, kurem) is order fields or sloppy SKU pick, not new procedures.
closedDecisions.why: WO writes combo sites on whichever paraffin row was handy.

closedDecisions.decision: Do not map whole-word bas to HEAD when barmaq is present (baş barmaq = hallux/thumb).
closedDecisions.why: Matcher bug: her iki ayaq bas barmaq → ZONE-HEAD.

closedDecisions.decision: böyrəküstü / böyrək üstü = ZONE-LUMBOSACRAL (lumbar / above the kidneys). Not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception closed 2026-08-25. Canon §6.2 no longer treats this as mint-queue anatomy.

closedDecisions.decision: her iki bizler = hər iki diz → ZONE-KNEE.
closedDecisions.why: WO typo bizler.

closedDecisions.decision: İnqalyasiya + sadə = plain inhalation, no additive. Not a site.
closedDecisions.why: Flags-only / NO_ADDITIVE. Site is the procedure type.

closedDecisions.decision: rus akimi = Kotz (Russian stimulation). seo/deo numbers are DEVICE_PARAMS, not Amplipuls I–V.
closedDecisions.why: BTL combo currents vs classic SMT work-kind.

closedDecisions.decision: 0 24 başla / başlamaq on UFB is a session start token (DEVICE_PARAMS), not a site.
closedDecisions.why: UFB empty already defaults full body; this token is leftover regime text.

closedDecisions.decision: Do not auto-mint S for fingers-as-named, quadriceps/biceps named muscles, or other long-tail anatomy.
closedDecisions.why: Unmatched queue is first-class. SatAdmin synonyms after review.

closedDecisions.decision: Planning: four boxes, six couches. BTL 4000 between 7∥8 and between 10∥11 (2 paws/output; any electro procedures in parallel, same or different). UNISTIM 5S on 12 and BTL 4825S Premium on 13 (4 paws; also 2-pad; US on 4825S unused). FIFO only: 12/13 are ordinary 2-pad resources — do not hold for 4 lü. 4 lü / 4-pole IFC → 12 or 13 when free (capability, not priority). Cabin 14 not in ERA. US/UFF 15–16 oil, 17 gel. One electro nurse on all six couches. Separate ProcedureTypes, shared resources. Cutover #40 LOCATION pool stays 7–13.
closedDecisions.why: Floor wiring + med brother 2026-08-26. Placement is FIFO (placeConfirmedProcedures). Not runtime schema until the resource wave.

closedDecisions.decision: dizdən aşağı / dizlərdən aşaği / asagi eyaqlar = below the knee → ZONE-FOOT-LEG. Not ZONE-LOWER-LIMB (that includes thigh).
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-25. Paraffin bütün bədən + below-knee nahiye is sloppy SKU, site still FOOT-LEG.

closedDecisions.decision: baldır = crus (ZONE-FOOT-LEG). bud / bud nahiyəsi = thigh → ZONE-HIP-GLUTEAL. Not interchangeable.
closedDecisions.why: Russian ляжка is bud, not baldır.

closedDecisions.decision: artroz pr / artrit rej / artroz b rej / (b) = named stim program on the combo. Not PRP. PRP is SVC-PRP-TERAPIYA.
closedDecisions.why: pr = proqram; (b) = protocol B. Same rows as TENS / 4 basliqli.

closedDecisions.decision: Leftover ayaq / eyaq after laterality = ZONE-LOWER-LIMB (sol ayaq = left leg). ayaqlar alti = sole → ZONE-FOOT-LEG. Hallux phrases (ayaq bas barmaq) stay longer and still win.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Bare ayaq is leg unless a longer foot/toe phrase matches.

closedDecisions.decision: quadriseps / hamstring → ZONE-HIP-GLUTEAL (thigh). Do not mint a muscle S. Bare biceps is not arm when next to quad (biceps femoris) — only via composite.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-25. Rotator cuff (supra/infraspinatus) still unmatched.

closedDecisions.decision: ödem pr / dermo rej / ekzema pr / artrit rejimilə / artroz pr (b) are named device programs (often Lazerterapiya). Same DEVICE_PROGRAM field. Not PRP, not S. Do not alias bare pr.
closedDecisions.why: pr = proqram. Laser SKU is separate; nahiye holds the template name.

closedDecisions.decision: turunda / tampon = tampon procedure, not a site. Remaining tokens (qulaq / burun) are the S.
closedDecisions.why: SVC-TURUNDA-BURUN-VE-QULAQ.

closedDecisions.decision: çoban yastığı = chamomile additive (inhalation), not a site.
closedDecisions.why: Same class as bitkilərlə.

closedDecisions.decision: qoltuqaltı → ZONE-UPPER-LIMB. No dedicated axilla S.
closedDecisions.why: Not in the 31 protocol sites.

closedDecisions.decision: ayaq topuqlarina = malleolus / ZONE-ANKLE (bump by Achilles), not a new foot point. Heel stays daban.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-25.

closedDecisions.decision: diz oynagi / diz oynağı / dizətrafi = ZONE-KNEE (knee joint / peri-knee). Not a ligament S. dizəqədər = ZONE-FOOT-LEG (to the knee).
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Same 817 §23 site.

closedDecisions.decision: aşagi hissəsi / aşagi hissə = APPLICATION_SURFACE (lower portion of the already chosen S), not a new zone. Do not alias bare aşağı / aşagi (ambiguous низ).
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. yuxari hissə is the same class (upper portion).

closedDecisions.decision: sargi nahiyyesi is a dressing/bandage area, not an 817 S. Unmatched queue.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: kürəkalti = subscapular → ZONE-BACK. qabırğa üstü → ZONE-CHEST. Not extra S codes.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: dumbek / dumbek nahiyesi = sacrum → ZONE-LUMBOSACRAL (lumbosacral includes sacrum). Not coccyx (büzdüm), not perineum.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Clarified as крестец, still the same 817 lumbosacral S.

closedDecisions.decision: venalara = veins, not an 817 S. Unmatched queue. Do not map to a limb.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: oma = omba = ZONE-LUMBOSACRAL (same as bel oma). Not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: doş / dos / döş = chest (ZONE-CHEST). döş qəfəsinə qədər ombaya olmaz on Parafin Yuxarı = apply to chest, HOLD lumbar.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: aşagi hissəsi / yuxari hissə = APPLICATION_SURFACE (lower/upper portion of the already chosen S). Not LOWER-LIMB / UPPER-LIMB. Bare aşağı still unmatched.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: ətraflar = around (stop word). Longer asagi etraflara / yuxari etraf still win as limb S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: 4 basliql hem servikal hem lumbar / 4 basliqli … boyun … bel oma = COLLAR + LUMBOSACRAL + 4-pad. karipazin/dimeksid stay substance. iki basligi / basligi = electrode tokens, not anatomy.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: baş barmağa / bas barmaga = hallux or thumb (ZONE-FOOT-LEG / already chosen digit S). AZ baş barmaq is not index finger. Do not mint a finger S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 (указательный in the note = that digit, not a new code).

closedDecisions.decision: bazu nahiyəsi = brachium (humerus, elbow to shoulder) → ZONE-UPPER-LIMB. No dedicated arm-bone S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: canaqdan aşağı = below the pelvis → ZONE-LOWER-LIMB (includes thigh). Not FOOT-LEG. canaq / çanaq itself stays HIP-GLUTEAL.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: artroz/artrit … (b) / brej / b rej = named stim program variant B. Same DEVICE_PROGRAM field. Isolated letter b is not a token.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. WO writes (b) on many arthritis/artrosis rows.

closedDecisions.decision: leftover art after a site (e.g. onurga boyu art) = artroz program, not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: x altı = under that S (daban altı / ayaqaltı = sole; diz altina = under the knee). Do not strip generic altı as a field — it would steal sole phrases into leftover ayaq = LOWER-LIMB.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: furun in nahiye = burun (nose) → ZONE-FACE. Not turunda/tampon unless turunda is also written.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: raloji rej on Elektroforez = nevraloji (neurological stim program), not radiology. Same DEVICE_PROGRAM as nevraloji rej.
closedDecisions.why: WO 11 rows, same doctor as KY/BEF yaxaliq + nevraloji rej on Elektroforez. Reception thought radiological; procedure is electrophoresis.

closedDecisions.decision: ekstremite = limb(s). aşağı/alt ekstremite → ZONE-LOWER-LIMB. yuxarı ekstremite → ZONE-UPPER-LIMB. Bare ekstremite = both limbs (composite). Not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 (TR/LAT: kol ve bacak).

closedDecisions.decision: erector spina para vertebral = paravertebral erector spinae → ZONE-SPINE-FULL. Latin anatomy, not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: dizaltı / dizalti = under the knee → ZONE-KNEE. dizdən aşağı = below the knee → ZONE-FOOT-LEG. Not the same.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: 4 lü rej = 4-electrode regime → ELECTRODE_COUNT. Still not Amplipuls work-kind IV (that is 4 cu rej).
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: 1 ci / 1-ci = first (day or first sitz). 1 ci oturaq = first sitz, not BATH_SEQUENCE (that needs son tam). Longer 1 ci rej still wins as work-kind I.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: neloma / meloma = beloma typo → ZONE-LUMBOSACRAL. Not melanoma. Keyboard neighbours n/m vs b.
closedDecisions.why: Reception confirmed 2026-08-26. WO is Amplipuls (4 cu rej) and Super induktiv terapiya, not oncology.

closedDecisions.decision: asagi nahiye on Parafin Aşağı = ZONE-LOWER-LIMB (the lower-body paraffin site), not a surface-only flag.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Same SKU already named Aşağı nahiyə.

closedDecisions.decision: supraspinatus / infraspinatus (insraspinatus) → ZONE-SHOULDER. Latin muscle names, not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Amplipuls interferential on those muscles.

closedDecisions.decision: lateral/medial malleol = malleolus → ZONE-ANKLE.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: thorakal / torakal = thorax → ZONE-CHEST.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: axil veteri = Achilles tendon → ZONE-FOOT-LEG (shockwave). Not a new S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Zərbə dalğa rows.

closedDecisions.decision: ürək nahiyəsi after open-heart surgery = ZONE-CHEST + light INTENSITY + HOLD no pressure. Not a new heart S.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Massaj 30.

closedDecisions.decision: sagri = sağrı (haunch / HIP-GLUTEAL). sarğı (bandage) is sargi / sagir nah — unmatched queue. Do not conflate.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 wrote sagri = sarğı; WO shows bilateral sagri + karipazim and bud/çanaq/diz pairs — that is sağrı, not a dressing.

closedDecisions.decision: qollardan aşağı on Parafin Yuxarı + tam onurga = distal to the upper arm → ZONE-HAND-FOREARM (forearm/hand), simultaneous with spine. Not lower-limb (wrong SKU).
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 unsure. Distal reading fits upper paraffin; torso-below-axilla would duplicate the spine chip.

closedDecisions.decision: sakrum = sacrum → ZONE-LUMBOSACRAL (same as dumbek). Not coccyx.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: boyun yuxari bel / yuxari boyun on Parafin Yuxarı: yuxarı echoes the SKU. Sites are COLLAR (+ LUMBOSACRAL if bel). Do not treat leftover yuxari as UPPER-LIMB.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26: procedure name already has upper.

closedDecisions.decision: qıllar / qillara = qollar (keyboard i vs o) → ZONE-UPPER-LIMB. Not body hair.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26: letters are neighbours. Same pattern as neloma/beloma.

closedDecisions.decision: capiq rej / çapıq rejim = scar (keloid) device program, same field as kelloid capiq pr. Not a site.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 unsure of the word; Azerbaijani çapıq = scar. WO pairs it with artroz b rej on knees + abdomen.

closedDecisions.decision: fonofarez / fonoforez in nahiye = Ultrafonoforez written into the site field. PROCEDURE_NAME_BLEED, not a zone.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26. Catalog SKU is Ultrafonoforez (Naftalan yağıyla / Gellə).

closedDecisions.decision: 4 lü rejim = 4-electrode count, same as 4 lü. Not Amplipuls IV (4 cu rej) and not a named DEVICE_PROGRAM leftover.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26.

closedDecisions.decision: artroz rej b / artrit pr ilə(b) / leftover (b) = named stim/laser program variant B. Keep as DEVICE_PROGRAM. Isolated b is not anatomy. Meaning of letter B inside the device menu is still unknown.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-26 cannot yet name what B is; WO writes it on artroz/artrit rows only.

closedDecisions.decision: leftover butun is NOT a blind stop. t/r are neighbours: butun may be bütün (all) or burun (nose). If another site is already matched (butun ayaqlar) = bütün of that site. Bare butun on Massaj 30 / UFB / Parafin bütün = FULL-BODY. Bare butun on Trunda/turunda/İnqalyasiya = ZONE-FACE. Without a SKU, leave unmatched.
closedDecisions.why: Reception 2026-08-27. WO today: butun beden = Massaj 30 + UFB; butun ayaqlar = İnfraqırmızı. No butun on turunda yet.

matchRules.specificity: Longest remaining phrase wins. Bare boyun → COLLAR. Whole-word bas → HEAD unless barmaq (foot/hand digits).
